title: Normalised surface EMG of 14 trunk sites during maximal extension exertion (semi-seated)
condition: isometric maximal extension exertion, semi-seated dynamometer

quantity.name: normalised EMG at MVE
quantity.definition: RMS EMG (band-pass 30-450 Hz) normalised, per subject and electrode, to the maximum RMS recorded across all six MVE tasks (flex, ext, R/L lateral, R/L axial); so 100% = that site's largest MVE activity. Mean±SD over 19 subjects (sexes pooled).

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, El Ouaaid Z, Shirazi-Adl A, Plamondon A, Arjmand N
source.sample: 19 subjects (9F, 10M); healthy young right-handed adults, in vivo

protocol.summary: Bilateral surface EMG (Delsys DE-2.3, 1024 Hz) of longissimus, iliocostalis (2 levels), multifidus, rectus abdominis, external and internal oblique during two ~8 s MVE trials per direction in the semi-seated triaxial dynamometer (Lariviere 2001); trial with larger primary moment used.
how_to_simulate: Simulate the same MVE as in the matching ghezelbash2018.mve_moments test (semi-seated, pelvis fixed, measured primary+coupled moments about S1 applied at the harness contact).
Simulate all six MVEs for the subject; normalise each muscle's active force by its maximum over the six MVEs (as the paper did for EMG).
Compare normalised activation of model muscles under each electrode site (right and left: LGPT ~T12, iliocostalis ~L1 and L3 at 6 cm, multifidus ~L5 at 3 cm, RA, EO, IO) with these means.

subject_model.sex: 9F/10M (simulate each sex separately or a mean subject)

protocol.notes: Pooling note: El Ouaaid 2013 (same IRSST lab/dynamometer, same normalisation) reports L/R-averaged values at the same sites for flexion/extension; compare like with like (side vs average). Electrode locations read from the schematic Fig. 1 (paper cites De Foa 1989; McGill 1991); vertebral levels approximate. The paper's model-vs-EMG correlation: r=0.69 (ext), 0.76 (flex), 0.27 (lateral), 0.13 (axial) in Results (Discussion quotes 0.72/0.69/0.44/0.34).

data.site: right longissimus thoracis pars thoracis (LGPT); ~T12-L1 level in schematic Fig 1b (same-lab protocol in El Ouaaid 2013: ~3 cm lateral to midline at L1)
right iliocostalis (upper electrode) (ICPT); ~L1 level, 6 cm lateral to midline (schematic Fig 1b)
right iliocostalis lumborum (lower electrode, 'collected at L3') (ICPT*); L3 level (caption), 6 cm lateral to midline (Fig 1b)
right multifidus (MF); L5 level, 3 cm lateral to midline per Fig 1b (El Ouaaid 2013 same-lab text: ~2 cm at L5)
right rectus abdominis (RA); 3 cm lateral to umbilicus (Fig 1a; El Ouaaid 2013: ~3 cm lateral to midline above umbilicus)
right external oblique (EO); 10 cm lateral to umbilicus, along fibres (Fig 1a; El Ouaaid 2013: ~10 cm lateral above umbilicus)
right internal oblique (IO); just medial/inferior to ASIS (Fig 1a '2 cm' and '7 cm' dimensions; El Ouaaid 2013 same-lab text: ~2 cm below and 7 cm medial to ASIS)
left longissimus thoracis pars thoracis (LGPT); ~T12-L1 level in schematic Fig 1b (same-lab protocol in El Ouaaid 2013: ~3 cm lateral to midline at L1)
left iliocostalis (upper electrode) (ICPT); ~L1 level, 6 cm lateral to midline (schematic Fig 1b)
left iliocostalis lumborum (lower electrode, 'collected at L3') (ICPT*); L3 level (caption), 6 cm lateral to midline (Fig 1b)
left multifidus (MF); L5 level, 3 cm lateral to midline per Fig 1b (El Ouaaid 2013 same-lab text: ~2 cm at L5)
left rectus abdominis (RA); 3 cm lateral to umbilicus (Fig 1a; El Ouaaid 2013: ~3 cm lateral to midline above umbilicus)
left external oblique (EO); 10 cm lateral to umbilicus, along fibres (Fig 1a; El Ouaaid 2013: ~10 cm lateral above umbilicus)
left internal oblique (IO); just medial/inferior to ASIS (Fig 1a '2 cm' and '7 cm' dimensions; El Ouaaid 2013 same-lab text: ~2 cm below and 7 cm medial to ASIS)

extraction.from: Fig 4 top (yellow 'EMG' bars, error bars = 1 SD); Fig 1 for sites
extraction.check_notes: Pixel-based digitisation at 130 dpi against axis ticks (0-100); SD = mean of upper/lower whisker lengths. Fig 6 re-digitised independently at 200 dpi: all 28 bars agree within 0.5%.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD per site; pattern: agonists highest
